name: Ashes to Ashes
source:
You wake up and realize you are being buried alive by a cheerful-looking undertaker. It would be appropriate to attempt to convince him that you are not dead.

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/ashes-to-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来后发现自己正被一位看上去很高兴的殡葬承办人活埋。尝试让他相信你还没有死是适当的。

[来自[url=https://doksa.itch.io/ashes-to-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
